## Critique
- claim-1: Correct. Writing \(\rho=(x,y)\) with \(b\ge x\ge y\ge0\) gives exactly the stated ranges for \(y\). The two formulas agree at \(N=b\), so the profile is well-defined.
- claim-2: Correct. Each graded piece is spanned by a subset of the accepted integral basis, hence is free abelian and torsion-free; no partitions occur outside \(0\le N\le2b\).
- The strategy establishes the requested target from the accepted graded basis and makes no claim about the unresolved signed transition identity.
